Assigned Readings & Foundational Scholarship

Please study the following resources on critical apparatus architecture and digital textual editing:

  • TEI Consortium. "Chapter 12: Critical Apparatus." TEI P5: Guidelines for Electronic Text Interchange, Version 4.8.0, 2024.
  • Burnard, Lou. What is the Text Encoding Initiative? How to Add Intelligent Value to Your Digital Texts. OpenEdition Press, 2014.
  • Burghart, Marjorie. "The TEI Critical Apparatus Toolbox: Empowering Textual Scholars through Automated Processing." Journal of the Text Encoding Initiative, Issue 10, 2016.
